scripts.db:fresh: pnpm --filter api exec tsx src/db/db-cli.ts fresh
scripts.infra:reset: pnpm check:env && docker compose down -v && pnpm setup:local
scripts.infra:light:reset: pnpm check:env && docker compose down -v && pnpm setup:light
scripts.setup:infra: pnpm check:env && DEBEZIUM_SINK_URL=http://host.docker.internal:3000/internal/cdc/relay docker compose up -d postgres redis localstack mock_gateway pgbouncer mailpit debezium --wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.setup:local: pnpm check:env && docker compose --profile app up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.setup:light: pnpm check:env && docker compose up -d postgres redis mock_gateway --wait && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
